entities.summary: Església de Sant Joan de Caselles is a church located in Canillo, Andorra. It is a heritage property registered in the Cultural Heritage of Andorra, and was built in the 11–12th century. The 16th century altarpiece depicting scenes from the life and martyrdom of Saint John the apostle is considered of exceptional quality.
